2609.03493.title: Making Every Tool Call Count: Necessary Tool-Evidence Path Rewards for Agentic Vision-Language Models
2609.03493.paper_summary: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) can directly answer many image-grounded questions, yet they often struggle with complex queries requiring fine-grained visual details or external knowledge. To acquire this missing evidence, agentic VLMs invoke tools such as image cropping, image search, and text search. However, existing training paradigms primarily evaluate tool-use based on final answer correctness, leaving evidence acquisition and utilization insufficiently supervised. This leads to two critical shortcomings: (i) models frequently issue redundant or off-target tool calls that fail to gather necessary evidence, and (ii) even when appropriate tools are called, models often fail to extract the necessary information from the resulting observations. To address these limitations, we introduce the NTEP (Necessary Tool-Evidence Path), a novel annotation scheme that explicitly specifies the essential external evidence and corresponding tool calls for each query. Building upon this, we propose NTEP-R (NTEP Reward), a supervision mechanism ensuring that each tool invocation strictly advances the reasoning process toward the final solution. Specifically, our approach rewards the agent for aligning its pre-call intent with a necessary evidence-seeking goal, and for ensuring the information summarized from the post-call observation aligns with the necessary evidence. Furthermore, we introduce a non-repeated-goal regularizer to penalize redundant calls that revisit satisfied NTEP goals. Extensive evaluations on seven image-grounded benchmarks demonstrate that our 8B-parameter instantiation, NTEP-8B, significantly improves both search-oriented accuracy and tool-use efficiency within a unified three-tool framework. These results highlight the critical value of fine-grained tool-evidence path supervision for training robust agentic VLMs.
2609.03493.paper_summary_zh: 現代的視覺-語言模型（VLMs）可以直接回答許多基於圖像的問題，但它們在處理需要細緻視覺細節或外部知識的複雜查詢時常常遇到困難。為了獲取這些缺失的證據，具有主動性的 VLMs 會調用工具，如圖像裁剪、圖像搜索和文本搜索。然而，現有的訓練範式主要根據最終答案的正確性來評估工具的使用，導致證據獲取和利用的監督不足。這導致了兩個關鍵的缺點：（i）模型經常發出冗餘或偏離目標的工具調用，未能收集必要的證據；（ii）即使在適當的工具被調用時，模型也常常未能從結果觀察中提取必要的信息。為了解決這些限制，我們引入了 NTEP（必要工具-證據路徑），這是一種新穎的標註方案，明確指定每個查詢所需的外部證據和相應的工具調用。在此基礎上，我們提出了 NTEP-R（NTEP 獎勵），這是一種監督機制，確保每次工具調用都嚴格推進推理過程朝向最終解決方案。具體而言，我們的方法獎勵代理人將其調用前的意圖與必要的證據尋求目標對齊，以及確保從調用後的觀察中總結的信息與必要的證據對齊。此外，我們引入了一個非重複目標正則化器，以懲罰重新訪問已滿足的 NTEP 目標的冗餘調用。在七個基於圖像的基準上進行的廣泛評估顯示，我們的 8B 參數實例 NTEP-8B 顯著提高了統一三工具框架內的搜索導向準確性和工具使用效率。這些結果突顯了細緻的工具-證據路徑監督對於訓練穩健的主動 VLMs 的關鍵價值。
